description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Double class, which represents an XML-RPC double value in the Zend Framework. The class extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar and provides methods to set and retrieve double values, handling formatting with precision settings.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Double
classes.description: Represents a double (floating point) value in XML-RPC, extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar and handles formatting and retrieval of float values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the double value, setting the type and formatting the value with specified precision.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored double value as a PHP float.
